catalysts:
Friday October 23 is a regular U.S. session under the [NYSE official calendar](https://www.nyse.com/markets/hours-calendars); regular cash hours 09:30–16:00 New York (EDT). Preparation is based on Thursday October 22, despite UTC generation being October 23.

At 10:00 New York: final October consumer sentiment, [University of Michigan primary schedule](https://www.sca.isr.umich.edu/). The S&P Global calendar search lists U.S. flash PMI for October 23; 09:45 New York is reported by the [current public economic calendar](https://www.kiplinger.com/investing/economy/this-weeks-economic-calendar). Direct [primary PMI calendar](https://www.pmi.spglobal.com/Public/Release/ReleaseDates) retrieval returned HTTP 403, so reverify the time before use. Treat 09:45 and 10:00 as no-entry release windows pending post-release confirmation.

The [Federal Reserve calendar](https://www.federalreserve.gov/monetarypolicy/fomccalendars.htm) lists October 27–28 FOMC: an October 30 expiry crosses this event. These candidates are intended for reassessment intraday October 23, not an instruction to hold through it. Treasury auction, Fed-speaker and issuer-event coverage is incomplete; do not interpret the omission as no events. Single-name candidates are watchlist-only until issuer calendars are checked.
